evidence.provenance: experiments/static-contract/userspace-results.toml SHA-256 d67bb6084d6df83a85cd860443ce97a57f7b64c3e02fa915ebf0509816397dc5 pins the unchanged stock library/APK, analysis tool, reports, derived graph, inventories and raw evidence. IndexAuklet checked 1988337 instruction words against the pinned library; a deliberately changed listing word was rejected at the exact differing PC. No guest ran. The first incomplete heap-exhausted index is retained.
evidence.graph: experiments/static-contract/initialization-graph.toml contains 25 typed nodes using all five operation classifications and explicit conditions/decomposition links. The index validates node references and PC witnesses. hardware-callers.toml has 282 boundary candidates including 19 named R32 and 95 named W32 caller sites. mapped-wrappers.toml distinguishes R32/W32/W64 from the wave-data wrapper with no mapped access in its body.
evidence.semantics: docs/research/static-initialization-contract.md SHA-256 9e46f7257654146679af1568dcf183bfe5a4f29449753814b63b36abc37165c4 recovers the complete ADC initializer: 440 loop stores plus four constant and eight software-shadow stores, command masks/modes, requested delays and discarded statuses. Independent analysis agrees on all 440 words and the complete conditional tail. Selected SPU initialization has eight writes and two separate software mode selectors. ADC read bit16 and OTP bit4 dependencies are distinguished from software-shadow loads.
evidence.coverage: GOT-mediated ADC/SPU/WPU sibling calls and parent startup ordering are statically recovered and reconciled with the existing two-read/two-write dynamic prefix without claiming full-routine execution. The index retains 3466 indirect sites and 68256 unnamed direct targets; nearest-label ownership and runtime bindings remain explicit limits. Later selectors, serial helpers, DDR, DMA and FPGA behavior are not claimed recovered.
